reviewedBoundaries: Visible enabled controls only, including disabled fieldsets and closed details; radios retain one native Tab stop and arrow behavior.
Topmost sheet owns Tab/Escape; nested parent is inert and focus returns to saved opener.
Dropdown Tab closes its own menu and continues the surrounding modal from its retained trigger; selection redraw explicitly focuses replacement controls.
Prompt Enter suppresses bubbling and delayed focus is cancelled on early dismissal.
One bounded assistance scroller combines reply/speech help while the text draft, send and keyboard controls remain outside that scroller.
Composer geometry is tested in both themes across375/390/430px widths and430/480px heights, preserving a visible message region and exact unsent draft after reload.
limits: Source review plus browser fixture evidence; not physical iOS keyboard, VoiceOver or native-human accessibility review.
Explicit test Conversation provider only; no production-model quality/latency/microphone inference claim.
